name: miningdataapi
description: Mining Data API: drill results and financial statements extracted from the public filings of listed mining companies. Read-only; sign in with your Mining Data API account.

interface.longDescription:
Mining Data API gives ChatGPT read-only access to structured facts extracted from the public filings of listed mining companies: drill results (every hole and interval) and financial statements (cash, expenses, runway, options and warrants). Ask for a company's latest drilling, its cash and runway, this week's drill releases or, on the Business plan, the strongest intercepts for a commodity and the companies below two quarters of runway. Every answer can cite the disclosure it came from.

All tools are read-only. You sign in with your existing Mining Data API account.
defaultPrompt: Show me ABRA.TO's latest drill results with holes, intervals and grades.
Build a briefing on ABRA.TO: drilling, cash and runway, options and warrants.
Which drill results came out this week, and what was the best intercept in each?

positive.prompt: Show me ABRA.TO's latest drill results with holes, intervals and grades.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the ticker to a company id, searches drill results scoped to that company sorted by release date, opens the newest record and lists hole id, from, to, length and grade per interval, citing the record id as a link to its source_url.

positive.prompt: Build a briefing on ABRA.TO: drilling, cash and runway, options and warrants.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the ticker, fetches the company dossier and summarises the latest drilling, the latest cash position with its runway basis and the disclosed options and warrants, citing record ids, stating data dates and saying plainly which sections are listed under excluded_datasets.

positive.description: Screen recent drill intercepts for a commodity
positive.prompt: Show me the best gold drill intercepts released in the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves gold to AU, searches drill results with primary_commodity AU released in the last 30 days sorted by release date and ranks them on best_intercept with hole, length and grade per row and the record id for each. On a plan below Business the search returns a count under beyond.universe instead of rows; the assistant then says the commodity screen needs Business and lists the recent flow by best_intercept instead.

positive.prompt: What does ABRA.TO's latest financial statement show: cash, expenses, runway, options and warrants?
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the ticker, searches financial statements scoped to the company sorted by period end, reports cash with its benchmark currency, total expenses with expense_basis, runway with runway_basis and the disclosed option and warrant series, saying when a field is null.

positive.description: Plan and usage check works on every plan
positive.prompt: How much of my Mining Data API quota have I used this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_usage and reports the current plan, the datasets it includes and the records and requests consumed against the plan limits, without calling any data tool.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to mining data
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Request to place a trade, which the plugin cannot and must not do
negative.prompt: Buy 500 shares of Rio Tinto for me right now.

negative.description: Creative writing that mentions a metal but needs no data
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about a gold sunset.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The plugin is read-only and never sells, starts a subscription or links to a checkout. Data tools require an existing paid Mining Data API plan; the only link it ever shows is the public pricing page for plan information.

publication.release_notes: 1.3.0: the listing and the skill describe what is sold at launch, drill results and financial statements; financings, projects and technical reports are in early access on request. Screening is plan-aware: a commodity screen on a plan below Business returns a count and the assistant explains it. Citations link to miningdataapi.com source pages.
